title: Pinned artifacts and Codex engineering work
summary: Pinned Rasen Falcon v0.4 source remains available; Website Publisher v0.3 is on GitHub main and v0.4.1 fail-closed source candidate submitted to Autobuild. Do not treat source/pinned archive as an accepted CMS release.
invariants: Never infer accepted HTTPS runtime from the candidate 0.4.7 archive; the GitHub HTTPS package inspected previously was 0.4.6.
Use Autobuild two-commit ready-marker intake, not a direct merged PR or ad hoc writes to main.
No secrets in Git; only metadata, source and reproducible tests.
This sphere is a continuity/qualification artefact and cannot supersede executable package authority.
NoSQLServer v0.90 native candidate is qualified only in the Publisher development slice; v0.91 and live RexxOS/CMS operation require separate qualification.
